selection_scope: Previously unused upstream defects; fixture observations captured before touching product rules. The same root cause is counted once, not once per tool invocation.
execution_safety: Only public fixed Git trees, no credentials, synthetic-only file content, no external services; subprocesses isolated, bounded. No third-party target code execution on PR events.

families.bug_description: MCP server lists outputSchema but handler returns text-only; server SDK converts to isError true on successful tool invocation
families.target_scope: Output validation rejected by real SDK; RISU must not conflate isError from server with schema violation itself.

families.bug_description: read_text_file head=0 incorrectly treated as absent; returns entire file instead of empty text
families.target_scope: No schema violation; behavioral oracle required. An MCP schema validator cannot infer head=0 semantic intent without extra contract.

outcomes_definition.detected: Existing RISU 0.9.25 emits an issue-relevant finding against genuine BEFORE stdio, with no same finding on AFTER.
outcomes_definition.missed: Confirmed upstream defect manifested in BEFORE stdio but no issue-relevant RISU finding.
outcomes_definition.unverified: Capture could not establish the official defect within bounded isolated execution. Excluded from recall denominator.
outcomes_definition.false_positive: Issue-specific finding on matched AFTER normal record. Distinct from unrelated warnings.

limitations: Two upstream cases are hand-selected (nonrandom), recall is only on verified cases, no universal performance claim. No engine changes permitted before baseline score is recorded.
